$comment: Constructed from IATA ONE Record cargo ontology 3.3 concepts; see ../provenance.json.

awb_no.description: Master air waybill number identifying the consolidated shipment.

consignee_nm.description: Name of the organization designated to receive the cargo.

dest_iata.description: IATA airport code where the shipment routing terminates.

gross_kg.description: Total gross shipment weight measured in kilograms.

hwb_no.description: House waybill number identifying the shipper-level consignment.

load_iata.description: IATA station at which cargo is loaded for the current movement.

orig_iata.description: IATA airport code where the shipment routing originates.

piece_cnt.description: Number of physical pieces in the shipment.

planned_dep.description: Scheduled departure date and time for the movement.

shipper_nm.description: Name of the organization tendering the cargo.
